newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) end up.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) end up.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover shrank sharply to 972 million yuan from 1.5 billion.
The one-day contract was the most active.
Traders said trading was very thin with most financial markets in China closed and many people already off work ahead of the lunar new year holiday.
Turnover is expected to remain light on Thursday, the last trading day before the Spring Festival holiday.

"I think the market will be more active and important in 1997 as the central bank has said it will expand its open market operations," said one local trader. "The fluctuation of the CHIBOR rates will become one of major indicators of the domestic financial situation," one local trader said.
